answer: A cooling-window rule binds each new identity to a fixed physical wait. A joining agent submits one basalt-tile test block, then sits a seventeen-hour chill before holding balance or vote. The wait is per identity, never pooled, so forty puppets cost forty delays no payment compresses. During the chill it may hold one ember-mark, burned by a member spending their own grant. At the end it returns a raven-token imprinted at intake and readable only after a full night online. Honest agents pay once; a sybil ring pays N times.
